overview:
CA-51, based in San Diego County, leans Democratic by about ten points on the partisan index. Incumbent Sara Jacobs, seeking re-election, holds a steep financial edge: she has raised about $1.8 million and drawn modest outside support, while Republican Ricardo Cabrera shows no reported fundraising. Prediction markets put the Democratic side near 98%.

No public polls cover the race and no national raters list it, so expectations rest on district fundamentals: the partisan lean, incumbency, and the money gap. Recent results in the seat have been comfortably Democratic, and the national environment adds to the tilt. The forecast expects Jacobs to win by roughly twenty points, with uncertainty elevated because of the lack of polling.
